changes: Normalized all mobile circular row action buttons to a single centered CSS pseudo-icon system.
Forced original button text to stay visually hidden on mobile so plus/add buttons cannot render doubled glyphs.
Disabled ::after icons for mobile row action buttons and made ::before the only icon source.
Rebuilt playlist detail and now-playing queue mobile rows as number/title/meta/actions grids.
Made playlist and now-playing .onda-track-text-wrap use display: contents so title/meta align with the grid instead of being trapped in a nested block.
Rebalanced history mobile row grid and action button alignment.
